items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Clearing out a retail space can be a major undertaking, but Live Junk Free makes it straightforward and efficient. We offer fast, dependable retail cleanout services for store owners, property managers, and commercial landlords throughout the area.

Whether you are rebranding, relocating, or closing your shop, we have got you covered. From display cases and shelving units to unsold inventory and promotional materials, we remove it all. Regardless of your space’s size or condition, our crew arrives prepared, handles all the heavy lifting, and leaves your retail property clean and ready for its next phase.

Need immediate service? We provide same-day and next-day retail cleanouts to meet your timeline.

items: , we specialize in all types of retail cleanout services, from small boutiques to large department stores. Whether you are closing for good, renovating, or just need to clear space quickly, our professional team handles everything with care, speed, and precision.

We specialize in removing all retail items – from clothing racks and display cases to unsold merchandise and promotional materials. No matter the size of your space or the amount of clutter, we arrive prepared with the right equipment and manpower to get the job done efficiently.

items.q: How much does a retail cleanout cost?
